subject: Co-sell invoice reconciliation — credit offsets & VAT withholding (Contoso)
messages:
From: Procurements - Contoso <procure@contoso.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Contoso Billing <billing@contoso.com>, AWS Marketplace Finance <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Received duplicate charges across marketplace / vendor invoices — need reconciliation

Hi Jasmine,

We're reconciling November cloud spend and noticed duplicate line items. We received: 
- AWS Marketplace invoice (Invoice #AMZ-20261101) charging list price for the subscription;
- Redwood invoice (Invoice #RWD-20261101) showing the co-sell margin on our Redwood contract.

Our AP team expects co-sell margin to be settled as a credit or offset rather than a separate bill that duplicates the marketplace charge. Also, tax queries from our EU finance team: are you applying reverse-charge VAT or withholding? We need a short written reconciliation and any evidence (W-8/W-9 or EU VAT registrations) so we can close our books.

I've attached our Contoso credit memo request template and screenshots of both invoices. Can you advise the correct invoicing flow and whether Redwood can issue a single combined settlement or a credit applied to the next invoice?

Thanks,
Marta Ivanova
Manager, Procurements — Contoso Cloud
[Attachment: contoso-credit-memo-request.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: aws-marketplace-invoice-20261101.pdf (pdf)]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Procurements - Contoso <procure@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Received duplicate charges across marketplace / vendor invoices — need reconciliation

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. We hear you and want to make this simple. Quick summary of what likely happened: 

- AWS invoiced Contoso for list price (standard marketplace flow).
- Redwood issued an invoice to Contoso for the co-sell margin component (we sometimes do this when customers have opted for direct settlement instead of marketplace-managed settlement).

Requests / next steps from our side:
1) Vanessa (channel ops) and Dev (finance) are looped in to propose the cleanest settlement path (credit vs consolidated invoice).
2) To confirm VAT/withholding treatment we need Contoso's EU VAT registration number and, if applicable, a withholding certificate. If you can't share those over email, please point us to the portal where AP stores them.
3) If you prefer Redwood to apply a credit, we'll create a credit memo against RWD-20261101 and apply it to the next cycle so you do not pay twice. That requires a signed amendment to the billing terms (one-line DocuSign). I can send that once we agree.

Attached: our copy of Redwood invoice and preliminary reconcile view.

I'll let Vanessa propose the operational path.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-invoice-20261101.pdf (pdf); redwood-prelim-reconcile-20261118.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Received duplicate charges across marketplace / vendor invoices — need reconciliation

Thanks for flagging. Operational options to resolve (pros/cons):

Option A — Credit memo from Redwood applied to next invoice
- Pros: Fastest for Contoso AP, avoids double-payment.
- Cons: Redwood will record revenue initially and then issue a contra entry (standard accounting). Requires simple credit memo + AP approval.

Option B — Consolidated settlement via marketplace (AWS collects net of co-sell split)
- Pros: Clean for customer (single marketplace invoice), AWS handles tax gross-up/withholding where applicable.
- Cons: Requires marketplace re-configuration and possibly a retroactive settlement with AWS; longer lead time (30–60 days).

VAT/Withholding specifics for EU (Contoso):
- If Contoso is VAT-registered in the EU and has provided a valid VAT ID, we generally treat the supply as B2B with reverse-charge; Redwood will not charge VAT on our invoice, and Contoso accounts for VAT. Please provide VAT ID (VIES check recommended).
- If Contoso is not VAT-registered or the marketplace rules require supplier VAT, we may need to show VAT on the Redwood invoice.
- For US tax withholding (W-8/W-9): if Contoso is a US entity, we need W-9; otherwise W-8BEN-E for non-US entities claiming treaty benefits.

Required documentation to proceed quickly:
1) Contoso EU VAT ID (or confirmation to treat as non-registered).
2) Copy of AWS invoice line items (we already have);
3) Signed DocuSign (one-line amendment) to indicate Redwood will issue a credit memo vs customer-requested alternative (template link below).

Suggested course: Issue credit memo (Option A) and we send a one-line amendment to Contoso for signature. Marcus — finance, please prepare draft credit memo (RWD-CM-20261118) and confirm GAAP description. Dev — can you check if there are any AWS marketplace settlements that should be rebated retroactively?

Link to amendment template: https://docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

Vanessa
Director, Channel & Marketplace Partnerships
[Attachment: none]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Procurements - Contoso <procure@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, AWS Marketplace Finance <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Received duplicate charges across marketplace / vendor invoices — need reconciliation

Hi Marta — quick update and requested next actions so your AP team can close the month: 

1) We will issue a Redwood credit memo (RWD-CM-20261118) equal to the co-sell margin amount on RWD-20261101 and apply it to your next Redwood invoice. That prevents you from paying the same economic amount twice.
2) For VAT: please reply with Contoso's EU VAT number (format: GB123456789 or DE123456789) or confirm you want Redwood to charge VAT. If you provide a valid VAT ID we will mark the credit memo as reverse-charge (no VAT charged).
3) For tax residency: If Contoso is a US entity we need a W-9; if not, W-8BEN-E for claim of treaty benefits. You can upload documents here: https://contoso.example.com/ap-portal or send to procure@contoso.com and CC us.
4) Attached is the credit memo draft (RWD-CM-20261118) and our one-line amendment (DocuSign link above). Please sign the amendment if you want the credit applied automatically in future co-sell settlements.

We appreciate the quick turnaround — if we have the VAT ID and signed amendment by next week we will be able to post the credit for November close.

Best regards,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-credit-memo-draft-RWD-CM-20261118.pdf (pdf)]
